abilities.name: Ledger Broker
abilities.text: Once per session, when you accept your first Contract, set its progress to at least 1.

abilities.name: Silent Audit
abilities.text: Once per round, after you clear a sector with no unresolved blockers, record 1 Leverage Note.

abilities.name: Debt Knife
abilities.text: Once per round, after you defeat an enemy while you have an active Contract, advance that Contract by 1 valid progress step.

abilities.name: Black File
abilities.text: Once per round, after you complete a Contract, record 1 Leverage Note and reduce scenario pressure by 1 if it is above 0. Weakness: Leverage Notes cannot be spent on battles unrelated to your Contract.
